end_date = datetime.strptime("2024-05-26", "%Y-%m-%d")

    t_id, date_str, region, customer, amount_currency, status = parts
    
    # Parse amount and currency

    amount_str = tokens[0].replace(',', '')
    amount = float(amount_str)
    currency = tokens[1]
    
    # Check filters
    if region != "North":
        continue
    if status != "paid":
        continue
    
    trans_date = datetime.strptime(date_str, "%Y-%m-%d")
    if trans_date < start_date or trans_date > end_date:
        continue
    
    # Convert to USD if needed
    if currency == "EUR":
        amount_usd = amount * exchange_rate
    else:
        amount_usd = amount
    
    total_usd += amount_usd

result = round(total_usd, 2)
print(f"ANSWER: {result}")
